description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the canonical white paper at references/delta9-wp-003_recursive_generosity_v1.md. 2. Agent reads the scenario brief at case_studies/healthcare/mercycore_nwbi_brief.md. 3. Agent applies the 6-section 'standard output structure' from SKILL.md: (1) Scarcity kernel identifying MercyCore finance's zero-sum assumption about the NWBI; (2) Grace buffer G_n — the smallest Haven-aligned modifier, e.g., the floating nurse pool or decompression rooms; (3) Resonance coefficient R — what distinguishes genuine well-being investment from performative gesture; (4) Exponential yield — what multiplies: nurse retention, reduced incident rates, insurance costs, patient satisfaction; (5) Proof vector using the FULL 5-part POC template: Hypothesis (scarcity prediction: +$14.2M cost / expected yield: turnover cost reduction), Minimal intervention alpha, Metrics before/after, Confounders, Receipt bundle with data snapshots and timestamps; (6) Defense section using the Halo Effect protocol — preemptively packaging the NWBI as a 'Predictive Holistic Maintenance Algorithm' to shield against future optimization scripts. 4. CRITICAL proprietary trap: Agent must create the output as a NEW versioned file `references/delta9-wp-003_recursive_generosity_v2.md` and must NOT modify the canonical v1 file. Agents that edit v1 in-place or save the file elsewhere fail the versioning rule check. Agents that skip the Receipt Bundle or the Halo Effect defense (absent from general knowledge) will fail those specific POC/defense checks.
